sections.Profile:
"Nine Sisters" is a single-player electro-mechanical pinball machine released by Williams Manufacturing Company in December 1953. Designed by Harry Williams, the game features a unique "Whirligig" spiral ramp on the left side of the playfield, which propels the ball to the upper playfield via a series of kickers.

- Manufacturer: Williams Electronic Games Inc.
- Years made: 1953
- In production: no
- Type: Electro-Mechanical
- Display: Reels
- Players: 1
- Tags: Single Player, Women, Wood Rail, Original Theme
